name: Checkbox
summary: Separate on/off choice, or several choices from a list. Indeterminate shows that only some of the items below it are chosen.
use: Agree to terms, pick several filters, select rows in a table.
avoid: One choice from a group: use Radio.
A setting that works straight away: use Toggle.
anatomy: Label (optional in Figma, required in code).
figmaProps: Show text / Label / Show hint / Hint text
reactProps: Partly selected. Uses the native indeterminate state.
behaviour: Clicking the box or the label switches the value. Space when it has focus.
a11y: Without a visible label: add an aria-label (for example in a table row: "Select Robert Trimp").
content: Label as a statement: "Send me updates by email."
do: Put options below each other, not next to each other.
dont: A checkbox that runs an action straight away.
